item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 21/Feb/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China tomorrow. It will be fine and dry with cool morning over the region. The monsoon is expected to moderate slightly in the following couple of days, and a replenishment of the monsoon will reach the coastal areas of Guangdong later on Friday. It will be rather cool and windy over the region over the weekend and early next week.
